title: Authentication
description: Generic authentication system with Laravel backend and React frontend. Supports email/password and OAuth (Google, Facebook, LinkedIn) authentication.
idea: Create reusable authentication components that can be integrated into any application. Features transparent background UI, progressive email/password flow, and multiple OAuth providers for seamless user authentication.

title: Architectural Fees Calculator
description: A web-based application for calculating architectural and structural engineering fees with a robust spreadsheet-style design. Features interactive responsive web interface with category settings, rates management, coefficients configuration, and real-time fee calculations.
idea: Create a comprehensive fee calculator that provides step-by-step calculations with formulas (Excel + Google Sheets compatible). Features clean separation of Inputs / Rates / Coefficients / Output, making it auditable and hard to break. No user login required, with options to save calculations and export to CSV.

title: Document Extraction and Self Training
description: An agentic system for extracting text from documents (PDF/JPEG) with reinforcement learning capabilities using RAG. Features OCR, vision models, LLM-based structured data extraction, validation, and self-learning from user corrections.
idea: Create an intelligent document extraction system that learns from user corrections. Uses Langgraph for agentic workflows, ChromaDB for RAG-based learning, OpenRouter for flexible LLM model selection, and Langfuse for observability. Supports schema management, re-extraction, and real-time accuracy validation.

title: Happy New Year 2026
description: A full-screen animated web page celebrating the New Year 2026 with blinking stars, fireworks, and a beautiful half moon. Features 50 animated stars with random movement, 7 simultaneous fireworks bursts, and elegant typography using Playfair Display font.
idea: Create a festive animated celebration page with a night sky theme. Features 50 font-icon stars that blink and move randomly across the screen, 7 simultaneous colorful fireworks bursts, a glowing half moon, and elegant 'Happy New Year 2026' text. Powered by GSAP for smooth animations and includes Railway self-destruction countdown widget.
